rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Residential rental property owners may not use algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rental prices. Software providers and other 'coordinators' may not use such software to facilitate agreements or coordinate pricing among competing residential landlords. The act covers algorithmic revenue management software and algorithmic devices that perform a coordinating function using nonpublic, competitively sensitive information. It excludes human-analysis spreadsheets, databases that only query unprocessed data, publicly available rent estimates, brokerage databases offered on equal terms that do not set or recommend rents, research or testing uses, and government affordability controls.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property owners and to coordinators (software or algorithmic device operators) that use nonpublic competitor data to set or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy levels.

rules.exemptions: Spreadsheets operating without AI that require human analysis; databases that only use an algorithm to query unprocessed data; research/statistical analysis/testing not used to set rents; free public rent estimates; equal-terms brokerage databases that do not set or recommend rents; government entities setting rents through affordability controls.
rules.effective_date_note: The passages state the signing date (July 20) but no effective date. The status as of the query date is assumed, not confirmed.
